purpose: SOP 2 - operating system, kernel, system architecture and resource limits

collection.method: read-only shell collection; no config change, no reboot, no service kill, no benchmark

field_status_legend.system_report: value reported by the running operating system
field_status_legend.tool_report: value reported by a vendor or third-party tool
field_status_legend.measured: value observed on site during this collection
field_status_legend.unverified: not cross-checked against a second source
field_status_legend.not_supported: the platform does not expose the field at all
field_status_legend.not_accessible: the field exists but could not be read with the privileges used

base_image.value: vendor SD image (Ubuntu 20.04.4 userland), identical to the /mnt/wcroot snapshot archived in ../board_extract/
base_image.note: hostname, machine-id and os-release in the live board match ../board_extract/26_system_identity.txt exactly

boot_time.value: up 10:45 at the moment of the first batch (2026-10-18T21:08:24Z); /proc/uptime 38708.70 s idle 154355.11 s

boot_device.value: root=/dev/mmcblk0p2 (ext4 on the 58.4 GiB SD card)

boot_config.value: console=ttyPS0,115200n8 earlycon=uart8250,mmio32,0xe0004000 loglevel=8 root=/dev/mmcblk0p2 rootwait rw clk_ignore_unused mem=1024M
boot_config.note: mem=1024M is what fixes the PS memory window at 1 GiB; clk_ignore_unused suppresses unused-clock warnings

sdk_version.note: the full build string embedded in the kernel banner; the vendor SDK release is v2025.04

build.value: Linux version 5.4.52 (fmsh@fmsh-virtual-machine) (gcc version 7.5.0 (Linaro GCC 7.5-2019.12)) #3 SMP Fri Mar 13 13:44:29 CST 2026

toolchain.note: the kernel was built with the vendor toolchain; the userspace compiler on the board is Ubuntu gcc 9.4.0 (see software.json)

boot_protocol.value: PSCI v1.1, standard v0.2 function IDs, SMC calling convention v1.0

config_options_of_interest.value: CONFIG_ARM64_VA_BITS / page size 2048 kB huge pages configured; hugetlbfs mounted at /dev/hugepages with pagesize=2M; CMA 256 MiB reserved at 0x30000000; arm64 detected by systemd

markers_checked.value: /.dockerenv absent; no docker/kubepods/containerd entries in /proc/1/mountinfo; PID 1 cgroup is /init.scope

implication.value: all values in this archive describe the bare board itself, not a container view. There is no host layer to distinguish from.

accessible_scope.value: full read access to /proc, /sys, /dev and the root filesystem; no access was refused by permissions during collection
accessible_scope.note: the few fields that came back empty are absent from the platform, not blocked by permissions

other_accounts_on_board.note: read from the archived image snapshot, not re-read live; no credential material was collected

cgroup_memory_limit.note: neither the cgroup v1 nor the cgroup v2 memory.max / memory.high files exist; the process sits in systemd scope user-0.slice/session-N.scope with no memory ceiling

cgroup_cpu_limit.note: no cgroup cpu.max / cpu.cfs_quota_us; no cpufreq either, so there is no quota and no frequency scaling on this board

cpu_affinity.value: not_applicable - no affinity mask was set for the collection session, and no cpuset restriction exists
cpu_affinity.note: the cgroup cpuset controller is not present in /proc/self/cgroup

shared_memory_shm.value: tmpfs on /dev/shm, 497 MiB (half of RAM), 72 KiB used at the time of batch 3

hugepages.value: size classes registered (64kB, 2048kB, 32768kB, 1048576kB) but no huge page is preallocated (free = 0 in every class)

cma.note: the u-dma-buf driver carved a 128 MiB buffer out of the CMA pool (phys 0x30100000, size 134217728) for the NPU DMA path

interface.value: eth0, MAC ae:59:f4:2d:3a:99, MTU 1500, state UP, carrier 1, qdisc mq

dns.value: systemd-resolved stub resolver on 127.0.0.53 (no upstream server listed in /etc/resolv.conf)

link_negotiation.value: 100 Mb/s Full Duplex, MII, auto-negotiation on, link detected yes
link_negotiation.note: the driver logged 'Link is Up - 100Mbps/Full - flow control rx/tx' at boot. 1000baseT is supported and advertised by the MAC, but the link partner advertises only 10/100.

ntp_state.note: systemd-timesyncd is present in the image, but synchronisation state was not queried
